result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: low-contrast promotional banner text makes the offer difficult to read.

issues.description: The promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' uses white/very light text on a pale mint background, resulting in very low contrast and poor readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner text or use a darker background so the text meets contrast requirements while keeping the 'Order now' button clearly legible.
